body copy runs into the footer

slide.headline: Short enough
slide.bodyText: Silence removal runs on the transcript rather than the waveform, which means it never clips the leading consonant off a word the way a gate does. It also means the cut list is inspectable before you commit to it, so a bad threshold is something you notice while reading rather than something you notice after the render. The transcript is the artifact everything else in the pipeline hangs off, so it is worth the extra pass to get it right the first time rather than discovering it downstream.

accent is treated as a text colour, not a block background
photo with no fade under the footer
CTA slide with no visible ask
a standard slide is checked but its terminal-only rules are not

slide.headline: Standard slides skip every terminal check below the contrast pair, so this long body copy is not an overflow finding on this variant even though the same text would be on a terminal slide. Silence removal runs on the transcript rather than the waveform, which means it never clips the leading consonant off a word the way a gate does, and the cut list stays inspectable before you commit to it.
